::: {.column-screen}

::: {.sm-floating-math-bootstrap aria-hidden="true"}
$\require{html}\class{sm-math-probe}{x}$
:::

```{=html}
<div
  class="sm-floating-app"
  id="sm-floating-app"
  data-catalogue="../assets/lagrangian/catalogue.json"
>
  <div class="sm-floating-orb sm-floating-orb-one" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="sm-floating-orb sm-floating-orb-two" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <header class="sm-floating-toolbar">
    <a class="sm-floating-back" href="standard-model-lagrangian.html">
      <span aria-hidden="true">←</span> Editor
    </a>
    <div class="sm-floating-summary">
      <strong id="sm-floating-level">Loading selection</strong>
      <span id="sm-floating-count"></span>
    </div>
    <div class="sm-floating-actions">
      <label>
        <span>Speed</span>
        <input id="sm-floating-speed" type="range" min="20" max="180" step="5" value="80">
      </label>
      <button type="button" id="sm-floating-motion" aria-pressed="true">
        <span aria-hidden="true">Ⅱ</span> Pause
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main
    class="sm-floating-stage"
    id="sm-floating-stage"
    tabindex="0"
    aria-label="Floating complete Lagrangian. Move the pointer to guide it; press space to pause or resume."
  >
    <div class="sm-floating-field" id="sm-floating-field"></div>
    <div class="sm-floating-loading" id="sm-floating-loading" role="status">
      <span></span><span></span><span></span>
      <b>Typesetting the complete expression…</b>
    </div>
  </main>

  <p class="sm-floating-hint">The complete sequence streams through an open ribbon · Guide it with the pointer · Space pauses motion</p>
  <noscript>This view requires JavaScript.</noscript>
</div>

<script defer src="../assets/lagrangian/lagrangian-floating.js"></script>
```

:::
